findings.evidence: The first occurrence of `CommAlgCat.fppfTopology` is line 160; lines 70–148 use only `pointsFunctor`, `algSpec`, `yoneda`, `hopfSpec`, and `Spec.mapMulEquiv`, whose relevant APIs already live in the two imported CommHopfAlgCat modules.
findings.fix: Move the convolution presheaf declarations to `CommHopfAlgCat/Yoneda.lean` and the scheme-points comparison declarations to `CommHopfAlgCat/SchemePoints.lean` (or another earlier canonical CommHopfAlgCat module), leaving only the sheaf results in `Fppf/Basic.lean`.
findings.issue: `pointsGroupPresheaf`, `pointsPresheaf`, `schemePointsPresheaf`, and their comparison API (lines 70–148) do not use the fppf topology, so placing them under `Fppf` hides broadly reusable functor-of-points infrastructure behind a later site-specific module.

summary: The generic affine fppf site was moved appropriately, but topology-independent presheaf and Yoneda comparison APIs remain misplaced in the fppf module.
